note: The reason this is an allow-list and not a deny-list. ADR-007 names intent: specifically: it can launch arbitrary components with arbitrary extras, and anyone enumerating 'dangerous schemes' from memory forgets it. If the corpus contained only javascript: and file:, a deny-list implementation would pass the whole suite. Structurally valid JSON, so it MUST pass the schema — the scheme allow-list lives in the security layer.
